PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (1.95e-3, 1.4e-3, 2.3e-3),
    "R":     (420.0, 350.0, 480.0),
    "Rs":    (130.0, 90.0, 200.0),
    "gmid1": (10.0, 7.0, 15.0),
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),
    "Ib":    (50e-6, 20e-6, 150e-6),
    "Irf":   (0.5e-3, 0.2e-3, 1.5e-3),
    "Cb":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8

    I1 = p["I1"]; R = p["R"]; Rs = p["Rs"]; gmid1 = p["gmid1"]; L1 = p["L1"]
    Ib = p["Ib"]; Irf = p["Irf"]; Cb = p["Cb"]

    vs = I1 * Rs
    if vs > vcm - 0.15:
        vs = vcm - 0.15
    Rf = (vcm - vs) / Irf
    Ik = Irf + Ib

    ms = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, Ib, vds=0.7, vsb=vs)
    W1 = ms.W * I1 / Ib
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, I1, vds=0.6, vsb=vs)

    mr = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    wn = mr.W / iref
    mp = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=1.0)
    wp = mp.W / iref

    nf1 = max(1, int(round(W1 / 5.0)))
    nfk = max(1, int(round(wn * Ik / 5.0)))
    nfp = max(1, int(round(wp * Ib / 5.0)))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * iref, 1.0)
    n.M("Mk", "f", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * Ik, 1.0, m=nfk)
    n.M("Mb", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * iref, 1.0)
    n.M("Mp1", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp * iref, 1.0)
    n.M("Mp2", "e", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp * Ib, 1.0, m=nfp)
    n.R("Rf", "vin", "f", Rf)
    n.C("Cf", "vin", "f", Cb)
    n.M("Ms", "e", "e", "f", "vss", "nfet", ms.W, L1)
    n.C("Ce", "vin", "e", Cb)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "e", "s", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=nf1)
    n.R("Rs", "s", "vss", Rs)
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "vout", R)

    gm = m1.gm; gmb = m1.gmbs
    Gm = 1.0 / (1.0 / gm + Rs * (1.0 + gmb / gm))
    gain = Gm * R
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    f3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * R * cout)
    gbw = gain * f3
    power = vdd * (I1 + Ib + 2 * iref)
    vout_dc = vdd - I1 * R
    up = vdd - 0.15 - vout_dc
    down = vout_dc - (vs + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    swing = max(up, 0.0) + max(down, 0.0)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
